Two cubes joined end to end: surface area of the cuboid, a Class 10 combination of solids question. Each cube has volume 64 cm³. Find the surface area of the cuboid.

• Side of each cube: a³ = 64, so a = 4 cm
• The cuboid is l = 8 cm, b = 4 cm, h = 4 cm
• Total surface area (TSA) = 2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(32 + 16 + 32) = 160 cm²
• Check: 10 faces of 16 cm² show, 2 hide at the joint
